# Independent interoperability fixtures

The synthetic fixture data in this directory is dedicated to the public domain under **CC0-1.0**. It contains no customer workbooks. The repository's code remains under its existing license.

`basic.fods` is hand-authored Flat ODF, not generated by OpenSheet or SheetJS. `manifest.json` indexes the covered features, expected scalar results, known losses and independent-reader procedure. The generated evidence preserves source FODS plus LibreOffice-authored XLSX, OpenSheet-exported XLSX and LibreOffice-reopened XLSX with SHA-256 hashes. The automated fixture tests consume those saved files; they do not require LibreOffice in CI.

The current reader is LibreOfficeDev 26.8.0.0.alpha0. This is an alpha build, not evidence for all stable LibreOffice releases or Excel. Its boolean-to-formula rewrite is recorded as a difference, not hidden by converting `1` back to `true`. LibreOffice documents TYPE result `8` as a formula in its [information functions reference](https://help.libreoffice.org/latest/en-GB/text/scalc/01/04060104.html). Consequently the TYPE probe distinguishes the changed cell representation, rather than establishing a different logical result.

Stylesheets/font rendering, exact column widths, images/charts/macros, validation, conditional formatting and visual review are not established by this fixture. Further feature-indexed fixtures are still required before IO-01/IO-03 can close.
